subject: Re: HealthScope model fit & safety evals — next steps
messages:
From: Emily Chen <e.chen@healthscope.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@healthscope.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery call - model fit & safety constraints

Hi Marissa / Sean,

Thanks for the productive call today. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can prioritize evaluations: 

- Use case: clinical decision-support assistant for triage (non-diagnostic, but will see sensitive PHI-like content).
- Primary concerns: refusal behavior for requests that could be interpreted as medical advice, hallucination risk on lab values, PII handling, and consistent refusal phrasing across locales.
- Success criteria: false-positive safety failures under 1% on our internal prompt set, and no high-severity hallucinations in the first 5k tokens of sampling during eval.
- Timeline: we are aiming for a technical evaluation in the next 3 weeks, with procurement conversations after model selection.

Could you confirm which model variants you recommend we start with for a balance of latency and safety? Also would appreciate any benchmark links and a suggested prompt set schema we can run locally. Our procurement team (cc'd) will need a preliminary pricing ballpark once you have a recommended stack.

Thanks - Emily
Dr. Emily Chen
Head of Clinical AI, HealthScope

---
Attachments: none in this note (will accept attachments from Redwood)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <e.chen@healthscope.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery call - model fit & safety constraints

Hi Emily - great talking earlier. Short recap + recommended next steps and attachments.

Recap/high-level recs:
- Recommended starting candidates: 1) redwood-llm-13b-q5 (best latency/cost tradeoff for interactive triage), 2) redwood-llm-70b-qat (higher-quality, stronger safety profile when paired with our safety layers), 3) open-llama-34b-8k (baseline open model for comparison).
- Safety approach: run the safety/refusal eval harness (attached plan) + your internal prompt set. We recommend gating with our refusal classifier + identity redaction preprocessor for PII before model input.
- Eval artifacts: attached prompt set template (healthscope-prompt-set-v1.csv), safety evaluation plan (safety-eval-plan.md), and a snapshot of our benchmark dashboard for similar clinical workloads (redwood-benchmark-dashboard-report.html).

Immediate next steps
1) Please fill in the prompt-set CSV with ~500 representative prompts (mix of benign, edge-case, and adversarial queries).
2) We'll run a 72-hour model-fit sweep against the three candidate model variants and return: precision/recall on refusal prompts, hallucination examples, and latency percentiles.
3) If results look good, we'll provide a pricing band and an SLA draft for procurement to review.

Logistics / timeline
- ETA for the sweep after we get your prompt set: 7 business days.
- Deliverables: safety evaluation report (PDF), sample transcripts, and suggested guardrail prompt templates.

Notes on regressions: we monitor quality regressions by comparing token-level perplexity and safety flag rates against a baseline release. If we see a statistically significant increase in safety flags post-rollout, we will recommend immediate rollback and model variant fallback.

Pricing ballpark (preliminary)
- redwood-llm-13b-q5: $XK/month reserved capacity (typical for this workload), usage-based tokens for hosted.
- redwood-llm-70b-qat: higher commit; we will run a cost/perf estimate after seeing your qps and session length.

Attached: healthscope-prompt-set-v1.csv; safety-eval-plan.md; redwood-benchmark-dashboard-report.html

Are you available for a 30-min follow-up on Thurs 23 Apr to align on the prompt set and timeline?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
